# Godmode

> Godmode is one plugin for Claude Code and Codex, built from a single source. It ships nine workflow skills (revelation, gospel, prophecy, genesis, summon, judgment, sanctify, exorcise, covenant) that both engines load, ten no-auth MCP servers for docs, code intelligence, browser automation and Azure, and, in Claude Code only, five subagents and three hooks. It installs from a marketplace with no server, database or API keys. Apache-2.0.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/patrickking67/godmode/blob/main/README.md): what ships, install steps for both engines, the engineering decisions and where each is tested
- [Architecture](https://github.com/patrickking67/godmode/blob/main/docs/architecture.md): component view, the build's validation order, how one source field becomes two engine-specific outputs
- [MCP servers](https://github.com/patrickking67/godmode/blob/main/docs/mcp-servers.md): endpoints, launch commands, upstream repositories and the last live verification
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/patrickking67/godmode/blob/main/AGENTS.md): repository layout, build and test commands, conventions for contributors and coding agents
- [CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/patrickking67/godmode/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): setup, workflow format, branch naming, commit style, PR checklist
- [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/patrickking67/godmode/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): release history
- [SECURITY](https://github.com/patrickking67/godmode/blob/main/SECURITY.md): supported versions and private vulnerability reporting

## Source

- [Repository](https://github.com/patrickking67/godmode): source, issues and releases
- [Plugin sources](https://github.com/patrickking67/godmode/tree/main/src/plugin/_sources): workflows, subagents, hooks and MCP definitions (the single source of truth)
- [Build script](https://github.com/patrickking67/godmode/blob/main/scripts/build-plugin.ts): emits the Claude Code and Codex plugin and the site catalog from the sources
- [Generated plugin](https://github.com/patrickking67/godmode/tree/main/plugin): the installable tree both engines read
- [Skills](https://github.com/patrickking67/godmode/tree/main/plugin/skills): the nine SKILL.md files as installed

## Live site

- [Landing site](https://patrickking67.github.io/godmode/): install commands, the workflow and server catalog, how the build works
- [Catalog data](https://patrickking67.github.io/godmode/data/godmode.json): workflows (with full text), subagents, hooks and servers as JSON, generated by the build
